Part II · Chapter 5第二部分 · 第 5 章

Non-Gaussianity and Kurtosis非高斯性与峭度

Why mixing makes signals more Gaussian, kurtosis as a contrast, the landscape of kurtosis on the sphere, and the price of its sensitivity to outliers.

为什么混合会让信号更接近高斯、峭度作为对比函数、峭度在球面上的地形，以及它对离群值敏感的代价。

Go to chapter text直接读正文 Glossary & symbols术语与符号 Download chapter Python下载本章 Python

First pass第一次读这一章

Once covariance has been removed, ICA still needs a reason to prefer one direction. Kurtosis provides a fourth-moment score. The absolute value matters: a large negative score can identify a source just as a large positive score can. Learn the arithmetic before the optimization proof.

去掉协方差信息后，ICA 还需要理由来选择方向。峭度提供了一个四阶矩评分；绝对值很重要，幅度很大的负值也能像很大的正值一样标记一个源。先掌握计算，再进入优化证明。

After this pass, you should be able to:

读完这一遍，你应该能：

  • Calculate the kurtosis of a random sign and its two-source average.
  • Distinguish raw fourth cumulants from scale-free excess kurtosis.
  • Explain why zero kurtosis and algorithm convergence are not success certificates.
  • 能计算随机符号及两个此类源平均值的峭度。
  • 能区分原始四阶累积量与不受尺度影响的超额峭度。
  • 能解释为什么零峭度和算法收敛都不是成功证明。

Before you start: use the kurtosis definition and whitened model. You need squares, fourth powers and probability-weighted averages; constrained differentiation is needed only for the landscape proof.

先备知识：用到峭度定义和白化后的模型。先会平方、四次方和按概率加权平均即可；只有地形证明才需要约束求导。

Read first: the combination rule, the intuition in the algorithm section, and statistical weaknesses. Read estimator conventions before running code. Defer all critical points on the sphere and the multi-unit proof until the one-direction example makes sense.

先读路线：组合公式→算法一节的直觉→统计弱点。运行代码前读估计量约定。等单方向例子理解后，再读球面上全部临界点与多单元证明。

5.1 Mixing makes signals more Gaussian混合使信号更接近高斯

Section 1.5第 1.5 节 separated two sources by choosing the projection of the whitened data with the largest absolute kurtosis. The reasoning was a heuristic drawn from the central limit theorem: a sum of independent variables tends to be more Gaussian than the variables themselves, so a projection that mixes several sources looks more Gaussian than a projection that equals one source, and the least Gaussian projections should be the sources. Chapter 4第 4 章 showed that the sources are determined by the distribution of the data; this chapter shows that, for kurtosis, the heuristic is a theorem, and then examines what the theorem costs in practice.

Section 1.5第 1.5 节选取白化数据中峭度绝对值最大的投影，把两个源分离了出来。其理由是来自中心极限定理的启发式论证：独立变量之和往往比各个变量本身更接近高斯，所以混合了多个源的投影比恰好等于某一个源的投影更像高斯，而最不像高斯的投影就应该是源。Chapter 4第 4 章证明了源由数据的分布唯一确定；本章说明，对峭度而言，这个启发式论证是一个定理，然后再考察这个定理在实践中要付出什么代价。

ICA usually involves a handful of sources, so the limit theorem itself is not what matters. What matters is a statement for finitely many terms: a combination of independent sources sits, in a precise sense, between the sources and the Gaussian. For kurtosis the statement is simple. If s1,…,sns_1, \dots, s_ns1​,…,sn​ are independent with unit variance and the same kurtosis κ\kappaκ, then their normalized sum n−1/2∑isin^{-1/2}\sum_i s_in−1/2∑i​si​ has kurtosis κ/n\kappa/nκ/n, and no unit-variance combination has kurtosis larger in absolute value than the most kurtotic source (Proposition 5.1命题 5.1). The analogous statement for entropy is taken up in Chapter 6第 6 章.

ICA 通常只涉及少数几个源，所以要紧的并不是极限定理本身，而是一个关于有限项的论断：独立源的组合在确切的意义上介于源与高斯之间。对峭度而言，这个论断很简单。若 s1,…,sns_1, \dots, s_ns1​,…,sn​ 独立、方差为一且峭度同为 κ\kappaκ，则其归一化和 n−1/2∑isin^{-1/2}\sum_i s_in−1/2∑i​si​ 的峭度为 κ/n\kappa/nκ/n；并且任何单位方差的组合，其峭度的绝对值都不会超过峭度最大的那个源（Proposition 5.1命题 5.1）。熵的相应论断留到Chapter 6第 6 章讨论。

Throughout the chapter the data are whitened, z=A~s\bz = \tilde\bA\bsz=A~s, with A~\tilde\bAA~ orthogonal and independent zero-mean sources of unit variance and finite fourth moments ((3.2)). A one-unit method looks for a unit vector w\bww such that y=w⊤zy = \bw^\top\bzy=w⊤z is a source. In source coordinates, q=A~⊤w\bq = \tilde\bA^\top\bwq=A~⊤w, the projection is y=q⊤sy = \bq^\top\bsy=q⊤s, and ∥q∥=∥w∥=1\|\bq\| = \|\bw\| = 1∥q∥=∥w∥=1 because A~\tilde\bAA~ is orthogonal; in particular E[y2]=∥q∥2=1\E[y^2] = \|\bq\|^2 = 1E[y2]=∥q∥2=1. Searching over unit vectors w\bww is therefore the same as searching over unit vectors q\bqq, and yyy is a source exactly when q=±ei\bq = \pm\be_iq=±ei​, a standard basis vector.

本章始终假定数据已经白化：z=A~s\bz = \tilde\bA\bsz=A~s，其中 A~\tilde\bAA~ 是正交矩阵，各源独立、均值为零、方差为一且四阶矩有限（(3.2)）。单单元方法寻找一个单位向量 w\bww，使 y=w⊤zy = \bw^\top\bzy=w⊤z 是某个源。在源坐标 q=A~⊤w\bq = \tilde\bA^\top\bwq=A~⊤w 下，投影为 y=q⊤sy = \bq^\top\bsy=q⊤s；由于 A~\tilde\bAA~ 正交，∥q∥=∥w∥=1\|\bq\| = \|\bw\| = 1∥q∥=∥w∥=1，特别地 E[y2]=∥q∥2=1\E[y^2] = \|\bq\|^2 = 1E[y2]=∥q∥2=1。因此在单位向量 w\bww 上搜索，等价于在单位向量 q\bqq 上搜索；而 yyy 恰为某个源，当且仅当 q=±ei\bq = \pm\be_iq=±ei​ 是标准基向量。

Two coordinates for the same direction. w\bww is the direction the algorithm chooses in the observed whitened data. q=A~⊤w\bq=\tilde\bA^\top\bwq=A~⊤w says how much of each true source enters that projection. We do not know q\bqq in real data; it is a proof tool. A vector q\bqq with only one nonzero entry means the output contains only one source.

同一个方向的两种坐标。w\bww 是算法在观测到的白化数据中选择的方向；q=A~⊤w\bq=\tilde\bA^\top\bwq=A~⊤w 说明这个投影混入了每个真实源多少。真实数据中我们不知道 q\bqq，它是证明工具。q\bqq 只有一个非零元，就表示输出只含一个源。

The same idea appeared earlier in exploratory statistics as projection pursuit. Friedman & Tukey (1974) proposed to explore multivariate data by numerically optimizing a "projection index" over one- or two-dimensional projections. Huber (1985) argued that the Gaussian is the least interesting distribution, since most projections of high-dimensional data look nearly Gaussian, so that a projection index should measure departure from Gaussianity. One-unit ICA contrasts are projection indices of exactly this kind, applied to whitened data; under the ICA model the interesting directions are the sources (Hyvärinen, Karhunen & Oja, 2001).

同样的思想更早出现在探索性统计中，名为投影寻踪。Friedman & Tukey（1974）提出，在一维或二维投影上数值优化一个“投影指标”，以此探索多元数据。Huber（1985）认为高斯分布是最没有意思的分布，因为高维数据的大多数投影看上去都近似高斯，所以投影指标应当度量偏离高斯的程度。单单元 ICA 对比函数正是这类投影指标，只不过作用在白化数据上；在 ICA 模型下，有意思的方向就是源（Hyvärinen, Karhunen & Oja, 2001）。

5.2 Kurtosis of a linear combination线性组合的峭度

For a zero-mean variable, kurt⁡(y)=E[y4]−3(E[y2])2\kurt(y) = \E[y^4] - 3(\E[y^2])^2kurt(y)=E[y4]−3(E[y2])2 is the fourth cumulant (Definition 2.10定义 2.10). It vanishes for the Gaussian; variables with kurt⁡(y)<0\kurt(y) < 0kurt(y)<0 are called sub-Gaussian (uniform: −1.2-1.2−1.2; a binary ±1\pm 1±1 variable: −2-2−2, the smallest possible value at unit variance) and variables with kurt⁡(y)>0\kurt(y) > 0kurt(y)>0 super-Gaussian (Laplace: 333; centered exponential: 666). As a cumulant it has two properties that drive everything in this chapter: for independent uuu and vvv and a real number α\alphaα,

对零均值变量，kurt⁡(y)=E[y4]−3(E[y2])2\kurt(y) = \E[y^4] - 3(\E[y^2])^2kurt(y)=E[y4]−3(E[y2])2 就是四阶累积量（Definition 2.10定义 2.10）。高斯变量的峭度为零；kurt⁡(y)<0\kurt(y) < 0kurt(y)<0 的变量称为亚高斯的（均匀分布为 −1.2-1.2−1.2；取 ±1\pm 1±1 的二值变量为 −2-2−2，这是单位方差下可能取到的最小值），kurt⁡(y)>0\kurt(y) > 0kurt(y)>0 的变量称为超高斯的（拉普拉斯分布为 333；中心化的指数分布为 666）。作为累积量，它有两条性质，本章的一切都由它们推出：对独立的 uuu、vvv 与实数 α\alphaα，

kurt⁡(u+v)=kurt⁡(u)+kurt⁡(v),kurt⁡(αu)=α4kurt⁡(u).\kurt(u + v) = \kurt(u) + \kurt(v), \qquad \kurt(\alpha u) = \alpha^4 \kurt(u).kurt(u+v)=kurt(u)+kurt(v),kurt(αu)=α4kurt(u).

Micro example: mixing two random signs微型手算：混合两个随机符号

Let s1,s2s_1,s_2s1​,s2​ be independent, each taking −1-1−1 or 111 with equal probability. Compare one source with y=(s1+s2)/2y=(s_1+s_2)/\sqrt2y=(s1​+s2​)/2​.

设 s1,s2s_1,s_2s1​,s2​ 独立，各自等概率取 −1-1−1 或 111。比较单个源与 y=(s1+s2)/2y=(s_1+s_2)/\sqrt2y=(s1​+s2​)/2​。

  1. One source has mean zero, second moment one and fourth moment one. Its kurtosis is 1−3=−21-3=-21−3=−2.
  2. The four equally likely source pairs give y=−2,0,0,2y=-\sqrt2,0,0,\sqrt2y=−2​,0,0,2​. Thus E[y2]=(2+0+0+2)/4=1\E[y^2]=(2+0+0+2)/4=1E[y2]=(2+0+0+2)/4=1.
  3. Now E[y4]=(4+0+0+4)/4=2\E[y^4]=(4+0+0+4)/4=2E[y4]=(4+0+0+4)/4=2, so kurt⁡(y)=2−3=−1\kurt(y)=2-3=-1kurt(y)=2−3=−1. The absolute score fell from 222 to 111.
  1. 单个源均值为零、二阶矩为一、四阶矩为一，因此峭度为 1−3=−21-3=-21−3=−2。
  2. 四种等可能源数对给出 y=−2,0,0,2y=-\sqrt2,0,0,\sqrt2y=−2​,0,0,2​，因此 E[y2]=(2+0+0+2)/4=1\E[y^2]=(2+0+0+2)/4=1E[y2]=(2+0+0+2)/4=1。
  3. 又有 E[y4]=(4+0+0+4)/4=2\E[y^4]=(4+0+0+4)/4=2E[y4]=(4+0+0+4)/4=2，故 kurt⁡(y)=2−3=−1\kurt(y)=2-3=-1kurt(y)=2−3=−1，评分的绝对值从 222 降到 111。

The calculation compares equal-variance projections and shows why maximizing signed kurtosis would prefer this mixture to the source. It illustrates the exact population rule; it does not establish a universal ranking of non-Gaussianity or promise that finite-sample optimization always succeeds.

这比较的是方差相同的投影，并说明若直接最大化带符号峭度，就会偏爱这个混合而不是源。它展示了精确的总体公式，却没有定义非高斯性的万能排序，也不能保证有限样本优化总会成功。

Quick check 1. For the same random sign, what are the raw and normalized kurtoses of 2s12s_12s1​?

自测 1。对同一个随机符号，2s12s_12s1​ 的原始峭度与归一化峭度分别是多少？

Check the answer查看答案

The raw value is 24(−2)=−322^4(-2)=-3224(−2)=−32. Its variance is 444, so the normalized value is −32/42=−2-32/4^2=-2−32/42=−2. Raw kurtosis scales with the fourth power; excess kurtosis does not.

原始值为 24(−2)=−322^4(-2)=-3224(−2)=−32。其方差为 444，所以归一化值为 −32/42=−2-32/4^2=-2−32/42=−2。原始峭度按尺度的四次方变化，超额峭度则不变。

Quick check 2. If a unit-variance output has kurtosis zero, must it be Gaussian?

自测 2。若一个单位方差输出的峭度为零，它一定高斯吗？

Check the answer查看答案

No. It only says the fourth moment is 333. The three-point example has that moment and remains non-Gaussian. A fourth-order contrast can miss information that other statistics detect.

不一定。这只说明四阶矩为 333。三点分布例子也有这个矩，却仍然非高斯。四阶对比函数可能遗漏其他统计量能检测到的信息。

Three consequences shape the rest of the chapter. First, mixing can never produce more absolute kurtosis than the most kurtotic source contains, which is the precise form of the central-limit heuristic. Second, a mixture can still be more kurtotic than some of the sources: mixing a nearly Gaussian source with a Laplacian one gives a combination that is less Gaussian than the first source. Third, kurtoses of opposite signs can cancel: for a uniform and a Laplacian source, kurt⁡(cos⁡θ s1+sin⁡θ s2)=−1.2cos⁡4θ+3sin⁡4θ\kurt(\cos\theta\, s_1 + \sin\theta\, s_2) = -1.2\cos^4\theta + 3\sin^4\thetakurt(cosθs1​+sinθs2​)=−1.2cos4θ+3sin4θ vanishes at tan⁡4θ=0.4\tan^4\theta = 0.4tan4θ=0.4, that is θ≈38.5∘\theta \approx 38.5^\circθ≈38.5∘, although this combination is certainly not Gaussian. Kurtosis is a signed measure, and the quantities to maximize are ∣kurt⁡∣|\kurt|∣kurt∣ or kurt⁡2\kurt^2kurt2.

由此得到的三点决定了本章其余部分。其一，混合产生的峭度绝对值永远不会超过峭度最大的源，这正是中心极限启发式论证的精确形式。其二，混合仍可能比某些源的峭度更大：把一个接近高斯的源与一个拉普拉斯源混合，得到的组合比前者更不像高斯。其三，符号相反的峭度会相互抵消：对一个均匀源和一个拉普拉斯源，kurt⁡(cos⁡θ s1+sin⁡θ s2)=−1.2cos⁡4θ+3sin⁡4θ\kurt(\cos\theta\, s_1 + \sin\theta\, s_2) = -1.2\cos^4\theta + 3\sin^4\thetakurt(cosθs1​+sinθs2​)=−1.2cos4θ+3sin4θ 在 tan⁡4θ=0.4\tan^4\theta = 0.4tan4θ=0.4，即 θ≈38.5∘\theta \approx 38.5^\circθ≈38.5∘ 处为零，而这个组合显然不是高斯的。峭度是带符号的量，应当最大化的是 ∣kurt⁡∣|\kurt|∣kurt∣ 或 kurt⁡2\kurt^2kurt2。

By Proposition 5.1命题 5.1, the one-unit contrast in source coordinates is the quartic form F(q)=∑iκiqi4F(\bq) = \sum_i \kappa_i q_i^4F(q)=∑i​κi​qi4​ restricted to the unit sphere, and ∣kurt⁡(w⊤z)∣=∣F(A~⊤w)∣|\kurt(\bw^\top\bz)| = |F(\tilde\bA^\top\bw)|∣kurt(w⊤z)∣=∣F(A~⊤w)∣. Figure 5.1图 5.1 shows the landscape for two sources. With two sub-Gaussian sources (a), ∣kurt⁡∣|\kurt|∣kurt∣ has its local maxima at the two source directions and local minima at the interior critical points, where tan⁡2(θ−θ0)=κ1/κ2\tan^2(\theta - \theta_0) = \kappa_1/\kappa_2tan2(θ−θ0​)=κ1​/κ2​ and ∣kurt⁡∣=∣(1/κ1+1/κ2)−1∣=0.75|\kurt| = |(1/\kappa_1 + 1/\kappa_2)^{-1}| = 0.75∣kurt∣=∣(1/κ1​+1/κ2​)−1∣=0.75. With a sub- and a super-Gaussian source (b), there are no interior critical points with ∣S∣=2|S| = 2∣S∣=2; instead the kurtosis changes sign between the source directions, and ∣kurt⁡∣|\kurt|∣kurt∣ drops to zero. In both cases every local maximum is a source, as the theorem says.

Figure 5.1图 5.1展示了两个源时的地形。两个源都是亚高斯时（a），∣kurt⁡∣|\kurt|∣kurt∣ 的局部极大点位于两个源方向，局部极小点位于内部临界点，在那里 tan⁡2(θ−θ0)=κ1/κ2\tan^2(\theta - \theta_0) = \kappa_1/\kappa_2tan2(θ−θ0​)=κ1​/κ2​，∣kurt⁡∣=∣(1/κ1+1/κ2)−1∣=0.75|\kurt| = |(1/\kappa_1 + 1/\kappa_2)^{-1}| = 0.75∣kurt∣=∣(1/κ1​+1/κ2​)−1∣=0.75。一个亚高斯源加一个超高斯源时（b），不存在 ∣S∣=2|S| = 2∣S∣=2 的内部临界点；峭度在两个源方向之间改变符号，∣kurt⁡∣|\kurt|∣kurt∣ 降到零。两种情形下，每个局部极大点都是源，正如定理所言。

Two practical remarks follow. First, the absolute value matters. Maximizing kurt⁡\kurtkurt itself finds super-Gaussian sources, but if all sources are sub-Gaussian then F<0F < 0F<0 everywhere and its maximum is the critical point with the largest μ\muμ, which is the one with full support: the direction that mixes all sources (Exercise 5.2习题 5.2). An algorithm must either maximize ∣kurt⁡∣|\kurt|∣kurt∣ or kurt⁡2\kurt^2kurt2, or know the sign of the kurtosis it is looking for. Second, a source with κi=0\kappa_i = 0κi​=0 produces no local maximum at all: kurtosis cannot see it, even if it is far from Gaussian. We return to this in Section 5.6第 5.6 节.

由此得到两点实际的提醒。第一，绝对值不能省。直接最大化 kurt⁡\kurtkurt 能找到超高斯源；但若所有源都是亚高斯的，则 FFF 处处为负，其最大值落在 μ\muμ 最大的临界点，也就是支撑集为全集的那个点：把所有源混在一起的方向（Exercise 5.2习题 5.2）。算法要么最大化 ∣kurt⁡∣|\kurt|∣kurt∣ 或 kurt⁡2\kurt^2kurt2，要么事先知道所找峭度的符号。第二，κi=0\kappa_i = 0κi​=0 的源根本不产生局部极大点：即使它远离高斯，峭度也看不见它。我们将在Section 5.6第 5.6 节回到这一点。

5.4 All components at once: Comon's contrast同时估计全部成分：Comon 对比函数

One-unit methods find the sources one at a time. To estimate all of them together, search over orthogonal matrices U\bUU, with outputs y=Uz\by = \bU\bzy=Uz, and add up a one-unit contrast over the outputs. Comon (1994) proposed the sum of squared kurtoses,

单单元方法一次只找一个源。若要同时估计全部源，可以在正交矩阵 U\bUU 上搜索，输出为 y=Uz\by = \bU\bzy=Uz，并把单单元对比函数对各个输出求和。Comon（1994）提出了峭度平方和

Ψ(U)=∑i=1nkurt⁡(yi)2,y=Uz.(5.3)\Psi(\bU) = \sum_{i=1}^{n} \kurt(y_i)^2, \qquad \by = \bU\bz .\tag{5.3}Ψ(U)=i=1∑n​kurt(yi​)2,y=Uz.(5.3)

For outputs that are symmetric and close to Gaussian, maximizing Ψ\PsiΨ approximately minimizes their mutual information (Section 6.7第 6.7 节). With the orthogonal matrix Q=UA~\bQ = \bU\tilde\bAQ=UA~ we have y=Qs\by = \bQ\bsy=Qs, and by Proposition 5.1命题 5.1, kurt⁡(yi)=∑jQij4κj\kurt(y_i) = \sum_j Q_{ij}^4 \kappa_jkurt(yi​)=∑j​Qij4​κj​.

对于对称且接近高斯的输出，最大化 Ψ\PsiΨ 近似于最小化输出的互信息（Section 6.7第 6.7 节）。记正交矩阵 Q=UA~\bQ = \bU\tilde\bAQ=UA~，则 y=Qs\by = \bQ\bsy=Qs，并由Proposition 5.1命题 5.1得 kurt⁡(yi)=∑jQij4κj\kurt(y_i) = \sum_j Q_{ij}^4 \kappa_jkurt(yi​)=∑j​Qij4​κj​。

Proposition 5.4 (Comon's kurtosis contrast)命题 5.4（Comon 峭度对比函数）

For every orthogonal U\bUU, Ψ(U)≤∑jκj2\Psi(\bU) \le \sum_j \kappa_j^2Ψ(U)≤∑j​κj2​. If at most one source has zero kurtosis, equality holds if and only if Q=UA~\bQ = \bU\tilde\bAQ=UA~ is a signed permutation matrix, that is, if and only if U\bUU separates the sources.

对任意正交矩阵 U\bUU，Ψ(U)≤∑jκj2\Psi(\bU) \le \sum_j \kappa_j^2Ψ(U)≤∑j​κj2​。若至多一个源的峭度为零，则等号成立当且仅当 Q=UA~\bQ = \bU\tilde\bAQ=UA~ 是带符号的置换矩阵，即当且仅当 U\bUU 把源分离开。

Proof.证明

By the Cauchy–Schwarz inequality with weights Qij2Q_{ij}^2Qij2​, (∑jQij2⋅Qij2κj)2≤(∑jQij4)(∑jQij4κj2)≤∑jQij4κj2\bigl(\sum_j Q_{ij}^2 \cdot Q_{ij}^2\kappa_j\bigr)^2 \le \bigl(\sum_j Q_{ij}^4\bigr)\bigl(\sum_j Q_{ij}^4\kappa_j^2\bigr) \le \sum_j Q_{ij}^4\kappa_j^2(∑j​Qij2​⋅Qij2​κj​)2≤(∑j​Qij4​)(∑j​Qij4​κj2​)≤∑j​Qij4​κj2​, because each row of Q\bQQ has unit norm and so ∑jQij4≤1\sum_j Q_{ij}^4 \le 1∑j​Qij4​≤1. Summing over iii and using that each column also has unit norm,

由带权 Qij2Q_{ij}^2Qij2​ 的 Cauchy–Schwarz 不等式，(∑jQij2⋅Qij2κj)2≤(∑jQij4)(∑jQij4κj2)≤∑jQij4κj2\bigl(\sum_j Q_{ij}^2 \cdot Q_{ij}^2\kappa_j\bigr)^2 \le \bigl(\sum_j Q_{ij}^4\bigr)\bigl(\sum_j Q_{ij}^4\kappa_j^2\bigr) \le \sum_j Q_{ij}^4\kappa_j^2(∑j​Qij2​⋅Qij2​κj​)2≤(∑j​Qij4​)(∑j​Qij4​κj2​)≤∑j​Qij4​κj2​，因为 Q\bQQ 的每一行都是单位向量，故 ∑jQij4≤1\sum_j Q_{ij}^4 \le 1∑j​Qij4​≤1。对 iii 求和，并利用每一列也是单位向量，得

Ψ(U)≤∑jκj2∑iQij4≤∑jκj2(∑iQij2)2=∑jκj2.\Psi(\bU) \le \sum_j \kappa_j^2 \sum_i Q_{ij}^4 \le \sum_j \kappa_j^2 \Bigl(\sum_i Q_{ij}^2\Bigr)^2 = \sum_j \kappa_j^2 .Ψ(U)≤j∑​κj2​i∑​Qij4​≤j∑​κj2​(i∑​Qij2​)2=j∑​κj2​.

Equality in the last step requires ∑iQij4=1\sum_i Q_{ij}^4 = 1∑i​Qij4​=1, i.e. column jjj equal to ±\pm± a standard basis vector, for every jjj with κj≠0\kappa_j \neq 0κj​=0. These columns are orthonormal, so they occupy distinct rows; if at most one κj\kappa_jκj​ vanishes, the remaining column is a unit vector orthogonal to all the others and is therefore a signed basis vector too. Conversely, for a signed permutation each kurt⁡(yi)\kurt(y_i)kurt(yi​) equals one of the κj\kappa_jκj​, each used once, and Ψ=∑jκj2\Psi = \sum_j \kappa_j^2Ψ=∑j​κj2​.

最后一步取等号要求：对每个 κj≠0\kappa_j \neq 0κj​=0 的 jjj，都有 ∑iQij4=1\sum_i Q_{ij}^4 = 1∑i​Qij4​=1，即第 jjj 列等于 ±\pm± 某个标准基向量。这些列相互正交，因而位于不同的行；若至多一个 κj\kappa_jκj​ 为零，剩下的那一列是与其余各列都正交的单位向量，于是也是带符号的基向量。反之，若 Q\bQQ 是带符号的置换矩阵，则每个 kurt⁡(yi)\kurt(y_i)kurt(yi​) 恰为某个 κj\kappa_jκj​，且每个 κj\kappa_jκj​ 恰好出现一次，故 Ψ=∑jκj2\Psi = \sum_j \kappa_j^2Ψ=∑j​κj2​。

Unlike the one-unit contrast, Ψ\PsiΨ tolerates one source with zero kurtosis. It also has a useful interpretation. The sum of the squares of all fourth-order cumulants of y\byy, ∑ijklcum⁡(yi,yj,yk,yl)2\sum_{ijkl}\cum(y_i, y_j, y_k, y_l)^2∑ijkl​cum(yi​,yj​,yk​,yl​)2, does not depend on the rotation and equals ∑jκj2\sum_j \kappa_j^2∑j​κj2​ (Exercise 5.6习题 5.6). Maximizing the diagonal part Ψ\PsiΨ is therefore the same as minimizing the sum of the squared cross-cumulants, which is the idea behind JADE (Chapter 9第 9 章).

与单单元对比函数不同，Ψ\PsiΨ 能容忍一个峭度为零的源。它还有一个有用的解释：y\byy 的全部四阶累积量的平方和 ∑ijklcum⁡(yi,yj,yk,yl)2\sum_{ijkl}\cum(y_i, y_j, y_k, y_l)^2∑ijkl​cum(yi​,yj​,yk​,yl​)2 与旋转无关，恒等于 ∑jκj2\sum_j \kappa_j^2∑j​κj2​（Exercise 5.6习题 5.6）。因此最大化对角部分 Ψ\PsiΨ，等价于最小化交叉累积量的平方和，这正是 JADE 的思路（Chapter 9第 9 章）。

5.5 Gradient ascent, a fixed point, and deflation梯度上升、不动点与逐个提取

Gradient ascent. For whitened data E[(w⊤z)2]=∥w∥2\E[(\bw^\top\bz)^2] = \|\bw\|^2E[(w⊤z)2]=∥w∥2, so kurt⁡(w⊤z)=E[(w⊤z)4]−3∥w∥4\kurt(\bw^\top\bz) = \E[(\bw^\top\bz)^4] - 3\|\bw\|^4kurt(w⊤z)=E[(w⊤z)4]−3∥w∥4 and

梯度上升。对白化数据有 E[(w⊤z)2]=∥w∥2\E[(\bw^\top\bz)^2] = \|\bw\|^2E[(w⊤z)2]=∥w∥2，所以 kurt⁡(w⊤z)=E[(w⊤z)4]−3∥w∥4\kurt(\bw^\top\bz) = \E[(\bw^\top\bz)^4] - 3\|\bw\|^4kurt(w⊤z)=E[(w⊤z)4]−3∥w∥4，且

∇wkurt⁡(w⊤z)=4 E[z (w⊤z)3]−12 ∥w∥2 w.(5.4)\nabla_{\bw} \kurt(\bw^\top\bz) = 4\,\E\bigl[\bz\,(\bw^\top\bz)^3\bigr] - 12\,\|\bw\|^2\,\bw .\tag{5.4}∇w​kurt(w⊤z)=4E[z(w⊤z)3]−12∥w∥2w.(5.4)

To increase ∣kurt⁡∣|\kurt|∣kurt∣, take a step along the gradient multiplied by the sign of the current kurtosis, then renormalize. The second term of the gradient points along w\bww; after normalization it only rescales the step, so it can be dropped:

为了增大 ∣kurt⁡∣|\kurt|∣kurt∣，沿梯度乘以当前峭度的符号走一步，再归一化。梯度的第二项沿 w\bww 方向，归一化之后只改变步长，因此可以略去：

w←w+μ sign⁡(kurt⁡(w⊤z)) E[z (w⊤z)3],w←w/∥w∥.\bw \leftarrow \bw + \mu\, \sign\bigl(\kurt(\bw^\top\bz)\bigr)\, \E\bigl[\bz\,(\bw^\top\bz)^3\bigr], \qquad \bw \leftarrow \bw / \|\bw\| .w←w+μsign(kurt(w⊤z))E[z(w⊤z)3],w←w/∥w∥.

With the expectation replaced by a sample average this is a batch algorithm; with one sample per step it is a stochastic (online) algorithm. Because ∣kurt⁡∣|\kurt|∣kurt∣ has no local maxima other than the sources (Theorem 5.3定理 5.3), the population objective has no spurious local maxima. This does not certify a finite-sample or stochastic run: sample fluctuations can create other maxima, and a finite step size can cause oscillation or failure to converge. Its costs are a step size μ\muμ that must be tuned and only linear convergence.

把期望换成样本平均，就得到批处理算法；每一步只用一个样本，就得到随机（在线）算法。由于 ∣kurt⁡∣|\kurt|∣kurt∣ 除源方向外没有其他局部极大点（Theorem 5.3定理 5.3），总体目标不存在伪局部极大点。但这不能保证有限样本或随机迭代的表现：样本波动可能产生其他极大点，有限步长也可能导致振荡或不收敛。它的代价是需要调节步长 μ\muμ，而且只有线性收敛速度。

A fixed-point iteration. At a critical point on the sphere the gradient (5.4) is parallel to w\bww, so E[z(w⊤z)3]−3w\E[\bz(\bw^\top\bz)^3] - 3\bwE[z(w⊤z)3]−3w is a multiple of w\bww. Hyvärinen & Oja (1997) turned this condition into an iteration without a step size:

不动点迭代。在球面上的临界点处，梯度 (5.4) 与 w\bww 平行，所以 E[z(w⊤z)3]−3w\E[\bz(\bw^\top\bz)^3] - 3\bwE[z(w⊤z)3]−3w 是 w\bww 的倍数。Hyvärinen & Oja（1997）把这个条件变成了一个无需步长的迭代：

w←E[z (w⊤z)3]−3w,w←w/∥w∥.(5.5)\bw \leftarrow \E\bigl[\bz\,(\bw^\top\bz)^3\bigr] - 3\bw, \qquad \bw \leftarrow \bw / \|\bw\| .\tag{5.5}w←E[z(w⊤z)3]−3w,w←w/∥w∥.(5.5)

In source coordinates the iteration is strikingly simple. For a unit vector q\bqq, expand E[si(q⊤s)3]=∑j,k,lqjqkqlE[sisjsksl]\E[s_i(\bq^\top\bs)^3] = \sum_{j,k,l} q_j q_k q_l \E[s_i s_j s_k s_l]E[si​(q⊤s)3]=∑j,k,l​qj​qk​ql​E[si​sj​sk​sl​]. 在源坐标下，这个迭代简单得出奇。对单位向量 q\bqq，展开 E[si(q⊤s)3]=∑j,k,lqjqkqlE[sisjsksl]\E[s_i(\bq^\top\bs)^3] = \sum_{j,k,l} q_j q_k q_l \E[s_i s_j s_k s_l]E[si​(q⊤s)3]=∑j,k,l​qj​qk​ql​E[si​sj​sk​sl​]。由于独立且均值为零，只有下标两两配对的项保留下来：四个下标都等于 iii，或者 j,k,lj, k, lj,k,l 中有一个等于 iii、另两个等于某个 m≠im \neq im=i。于是得到 qi3E[si4]+3qi∑m≠iqm2=qi3(κi+3)+3qi(1−qi2)=κiqi3+3qiq_i^3\E[s_i^4] + 3q_i\sum_{m \neq i} q_m^2 = q_i^3(\kappa_i + 3) + 3q_i(1 - q_i^2) = \kappa_i q_i^3 + 3q_iqi3​E[si4​]+3qi​∑m=i​qm2​=qi3​(κi​+3)+3qi​(1−qi2​)=κi​qi3​+3qi​。由于 A~⊤E[z(w⊤z)3]=E[s(q⊤s)3]\tilde\bA^\top\E[\bz(\bw^\top\bz)^3] = \E[\bs(\bq^\top\bs)^3]A~⊤E[z(w⊤z)3]=E[s(q⊤s)3]，归一化之前的更新为

qi+=κi qi3,i=1,…,n.(5.6)q_i^{+} = \kappa_i\, q_i^{3}, \qquad i = 1, \dots, n .\tag{5.6}qi+​=κi​qi3​,i=1,…,n.(5.6)

Let rj=∣κj∣1/2∣qj∣r_j = |\kappa_j|^{1/2}|q_j|rj​=∣κj​∣1/2∣qj​∣. One step maps rjr_jrj​ to rj3r_j^3rj3​ up to a common normalizing factor, so all ratios are cubed: rj+/ri+=(rj/ri)3r_j^{+}/r_i^{+} = (r_j/r_i)^3rj+​/ri+​=(rj​/ri​)3. 令 rj=∣κj∣1/2∣qj∣r_j = |\kappa_j|^{1/2}|q_j|rj​=∣κj​∣1/2∣qj​∣。一步迭代在相差一个公共归一化因子的意义下把 rjr_jrj​ 变为 rj3r_j^3rj3​，所以所有比值都被立方：rj+/ri+=(rj/ri)3r_j^{+}/r_i^{+} = (r_j/r_i)^3rj+​/ri+​=(rj​/ri​)3。若下标 iii 在起点处的 rir_iri​ 严格最大，则 kkk 步之后其余比值都按 (rj/ri)3k(r_j/r_i)^{3^k}(rj​/ri​)3k 衰减：迭代三次收敛到 q=±ei\bq = \pm\be_iq=±ei​，即 w→±a~i\bw \to \pm\tilde\ba_iw→±a~i​。峭度为零的源在一步之后就消失了。这正是非线性函数取 g(u)=u3g(u) = u^3g(u)=u3 的 FastICA；Chapter 8第 8 章把 FastICA 推导为近似牛顿法，并对一般的非线性函数分析其收敛性（Theorem 8.3定理 8.3）。

Deflation. To find all sources, run the one-unit iteration repeatedly, each time in the orthogonal complement of the directions already found. Once w1=±a~i1\bw_1 = \pm\tilde\ba_{i_1}w1​=±a~i1​​ is known, the constraint w⊥w1\bw \perp \bw_1w⊥w1​ reads qi1=0q_{i_1} = 0qi1​​=0 in source coordinates: the problem is the same with source i1i_1i1​ removed, and Theorem 5.3定理 5.3 applies to the remaining sources. This is the deflation approach of Delfosse & Loubaton (1995).

逐个提取（紧缩）。要找到全部源，就反复运行单单元迭代，每次都限制在已找到方向的正交补中。一旦求得 w1=±a~i1\bw_1 = \pm\tilde\ba_{i_1}w1​=±a~i1​​，约束 w⊥w1\bw \perp \bw_1w⊥w1​ 在源坐标下就是 qi1=0q_{i_1} = 0qi1​​=0：问题与去掉源 i1i_1i1​ 之后的问题完全相同，Theorem 5.3定理 5.3对剩下的源依然适用。这就是 Delfosse & Loubaton（1995）的逐个提取方法。

Algorithm 5.5 (kurtosis-based deflation)算法 5.5（基于峭度的逐个提取）

  2. 对 p=1,…,np = 1, \dots, np=1,…,n：随机取单位向量 w\bww，重复以下步骤直到 ∣w⊤wold∣|\bw^\top\bw_{\text{old}}|∣w⊤wold​∣ 与 111 的差小于容差：令 w←E^[z(w⊤z)3]−3w\bw \leftarrow \hat\E[\bz(\bw^\top\bz)^3] - 3\bww←E^[z(w⊤z)3]−3w，再令 w←w−∑k<p(wk⊤w) wk\bw \leftarrow \bw - \sum_{k < p} (\bw_k^\top\bw)\,\bw_kw←w−∑k<p​(wk⊤​w)wk​，然后 w←w/∥w∥\bw \leftarrow \bw/\|\bw\|w←w/∥w∥。记 wp=w\bw_p = \bwwp​=w。
  3. 返回 U=[w1,…,wn]⊤\bU = [\bw_1, \dots, \bw_n]^\topU=[w1​,…,wn​]⊤、解混矩阵 W=UV\bW = \bU\bVW=UV 以及输出 y=Uz\by = \bU\bzy=Uz。

The script below implements Algorithm 5.5算法 5.5 for three sources: a uniform, a Laplacian and a binary one.

下面的脚本对三个源（一个均匀源、一个拉普拉斯源和一个二值源）实现Algorithm 5.5算法 5.5。

import numpy as np

rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
T, n = 10000, 3
S = np.vstack([rng.uniform(-np.sqrt(3), np.sqrt(3), T),  # kurtosis -1.2
               rng.laplace(0.0, 1 / np.sqrt(2), T),       # kurtosis +3
               rng.choice([-1.0, 1.0], T)])               # kurtosis -2
A = rng.standard_normal((n, n))
X = A @ S

X = X - X.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True)                     # whiten: z = V x
d, E = np.linalg.eigh(X @ X.T / T)
V = E @ np.diag(d ** -0.5) @ E.T
Z = V @ X

U = np.zeros((n, n))                          # rows: directions found so far
for p in range(n):
    w = rng.standard_normal(n)
    w /= np.linalg.norm(w)
    for it in range(1, 101):
        y = w @ Z
        w_new = (Z * y**3).mean(axis=1) - 3 * w           # fixed point
        w_new -= U[:p].T @ (U[:p] @ w_new)                # Gram-Schmidt
        norm = np.linalg.norm(w_new)
        if not np.isfinite(norm) or norm < 1e-12:
            raise RuntimeError("Degenerate update; restart or change contrast")
        w_new /= norm
        done = abs(w_new @ w) > 1 - 1e-12                 # converged
        w = w_new
        if done:
            break
    if not done:
        raise RuntimeError("Iteration limit reached before convergence")
    U[p] = w
    y = w @ Z
    kurt = np.mean(y**4) - 3 * np.mean(y**2)**2
    print(f"unit {p + 1}: {it} iterations, kurtosis {kurt:+.2f}")
print(np.round(U @ V @ A, 2) + 0.0)           # close to a signed permutation

On this run the three units converge in 6, 5 and 2 iterations and recover the uniform source (sample kurtosis −1.21-1.21−1.21), the binary source (−2.00-2.00−2.00) and the Laplacian source (+2.78+2.78+2.78), in that order. The last unit has no freedom left after deflation, so it converges at once. The global matrix is close to a permutation:

这次运行中，三个单元分别在 6、5、2 次迭代后收敛，依次恢复了均匀源（样本峭度 −1.21-1.21−1.21）、二值源（−2.00-2.00−2.00）和拉普拉斯源（+2.78+2.78+2.78）。逐个提取之后，最后一个单元已没有自由度，所以立即收敛。全局矩阵接近一个置换矩阵：

UVA≈(1.000.00−0.010.000.001.00−0.011.01−0.01).\bU\bV\bA \approx \begin{pmatrix} 1.00 & 0.00 & -0.01 \\ 0.00 & 0.00 & 1.00 \\ -0.01 & 1.01 & -0.01 \end{pmatrix}.UVA≈​1.000.00−0.01​0.000.001.01​−0.011.00−0.01​​.

With exact expectations every unit would land exactly on a source. With sample averages the error in w1\bw_1w1​ is passed on to all later units through the orthogonality constraint, so errors accumulate along the deflation sequence. Symmetric orthogonalization, which updates all units in parallel, avoids this ordering (Algorithm 8.6算法 8.6).

若期望是精确的，每个单元都会恰好落在某个源上。用样本平均时，w1\bw_1w1​ 的误差会通过正交约束传给之后的所有单元，误差沿提取顺序累积。对称正交化同时更新所有单元，避免了这种顺序依赖（Algorithm 8.6算法 8.6）。

5.6 Statistical weaknesses of kurtosis峭度的统计弱点

The theory above uses exact expectations. In practice the kurtosis of each candidate projection is estimated from TTT samples, and the quality of the estimate decides whether the landscape of Figure 5.1图 5.1 can be seen at all. Kurtosis is a fourth-order statistic, so its estimate is governed by moments up to order eight.

上面的理论用的是精确的期望。实践中，每个候选投影的峭度都要从 TTT 个样本估计，估计的好坏决定了Figure 5.1图 5.1中的地形能否被看清。峭度是四阶统计量，所以它的估计受到直到八阶的矩的支配。

In practice the kurtosis is usually computed on standardized data, as in the code and figure of this chapter, because whitening standardizes every projection. Standardization helps a great deal for light tails and little for heavy ones: with T=1000T = 1000T=1000 samples the standard error of the standardized sample kurtosis is about 0.040.040.04 for a uniform source, whose kurtosis is −1.2-1.2−1.2, but about 1.11.11.1 for a Laplacian source, whose kurtosis is 333. Heavy tails make the estimate of a large kurtosis very noisy. Centering by the sample mean leaves both variances unchanged when m3=0m_3 = 0m3​=0, as for symmetric laws; otherwise it adds a term (Exercise 5.5习题 5.5).

对高斯分布，V=Vs=24V = V_{\mathrm{s}} = 24V=Vs​=24，即熟知的 24/T24/T24/T。对均匀分布，V=1728/175≈9.87V = 1728/175 \approx 9.87V=1728/175≈9.87，而 Vs=1152/875≈1.32V_{\mathrm{s}} = 1152/875 \approx 1.32Vs​=1152/875≈1.32；对拉普拉斯分布，V=1656V = 1656V=1656，Vs=1188V_{\mathrm{s}} = 1188Vs​=1188（Exercise 5.5习题 5.5）。实践中通常在标准化后的数据上计算峭度，本章的代码与插图也是如此，因为白化会把每个投影都标准化。标准化对轻尾分布帮助很大，对重尾分布帮助有限：当 T=1000T = 1000T=1000 时，均匀源（峭度 −1.2-1.2−1.2）的标准化样本峭度的标准误约为 0.040.040.04，而拉普拉斯源（峭度 333）的标准误约为 1.11.11.1。重尾使得对大峭度的估计非常嘈杂。用样本均值中心化时，若 m3=0m_3 = 0m3​=0（例如对称分布），两个方差都不变；否则会多出一项（Exercise 5.5习题 5.5）。

Heavier tails. If m4<∞m_4<\inftym4​<∞ but m8=∞m_8=\inftym8​=∞, the sample fourth moment has infinite variance and the preceding finite-variance T\sqrt TT​ normal limit is not justified. Student's ttt laws with 4<ν≤84<\nu\le84<ν≤8 are examples; their convergence requires heavy-tail analysis rather than the standard-error formula above. If m4=∞m_4=\inftym4​=∞ (ν≤4\nu\le4ν≤4), no finite kurtosis contrast exists. For ν≤2\nu\le2ν≤2 even covariance whitening is unavailable. Moment-free identifiability results can still apply, but the whitened model of this chapter no longer does.

更重的尾部。若 m4<∞m_4<\inftym4​<∞ 而 m8=∞m_8=\inftym8​=∞，样本四阶矩的方差为无穷大，前述有限方差的 T\sqrt TT​ 正态极限不再有保证。自由度 4<ν≤84<\nu\le84<ν≤8 的 Student ttt 分布就是例子，其收敛需要重尾分析，不能沿用上述标准误公式。若 m4=∞m_4=\inftym4​=∞（ν≤4\nu\le4ν≤4），就没有有限的峭度对比函数；ν≤2\nu\le2ν≤2 时连协方差白化都不可用。无矩条件的可辨识性结果仍可能适用，但已不属于本章的白化模型。

Outliers. A single observation x0x_0x0​ changes m^4\hat m_4m^4​ by about x04/Tx_0^4/Tx04​/T, so its influence is unbounded. A point ten standard deviations out, in a sample of T=1000T = 1000T=1000, adds about 101010 to the estimated fourth moment, far more than the kurtosis of any sub-Gaussian source. In one simulated sample of 100010001000 unit-variance uniform values, the sample kurtosis after standardizing was −1.18-1.18−1.18; appending a single value at 555 changed it to −0.64-0.64−0.64, and a single value at 101010 to +7.13+7.13+7.13. One point out of 100110011001 turned a clearly sub-Gaussian sample into a strongly super-Gaussian one.

离群值。单个观测 x0x_0x0​ 会使 m^4\hat m_4m^4​ 改变约 x04/Tx_0^4/Tx04​/T，因此其影响是无界的。在 T=1000T = 1000T=1000 的样本中，一个偏离十个标准差的点会使四阶矩的估计增加约 101010，远大于任何亚高斯源的峭度。在一次模拟中，100010001000 个单位方差均匀样本标准化之后的样本峭度为 −1.18-1.18−1.18；只添加一个取值为 555 的点，它就变为 −0.64-0.64−0.64；添加一个取值为 101010 的点，它变为 +7.13+7.13+7.13。100110011001 个点中的一个，就把一个明显亚高斯的样本变成了强烈超高斯的样本。

Sources with small kurtosis. Let sss be uniform with probability 5/75/75/7 and Laplacian with probability 2/72/72/7, both components having unit variance. Then E[s4]=57⋅95+27⋅6=3\E[s^4] = \frac57\cdot\frac95 + \frac27\cdot 6 = 3E[s4]=75​⋅59​+72​⋅6=3, so kurt⁡(s)=0\kurt(s) = 0kurt(s)=0, yet sss is clearly not Gaussian: its density jumps at ±3\pm\sqrt3±3​. By Theorem 5.3定理 5.3 such a source creates no local maximum of ∣kurt⁡∣|\kurt|∣kurt∣, and two of them make Ψ\PsiΨ blind to any rotation within their plane, since every projection onto that plane has zero kurtosis. More generally, a source whose kurtosis is small compared with the standard error V/T\sqrt{V/T}V/T​ is invisible to kurtosis in practice, however non-Gaussian it may be in other respects.

峭度很小的源。令 sss 以概率 5/75/75/7 服从均匀分布、以概率 2/72/72/7 服从拉普拉斯分布，两个分量的方差都为一。则 E[s4]=57⋅95+27⋅6=3\E[s^4] = \frac57\cdot\frac95 + \frac27\cdot 6 = 3E[s4]=75​⋅59​+72​⋅6=3，所以 kurt⁡(s)=0\kurt(s) = 0kurt(s)=0；但 sss 显然不是高斯的：它的密度在 ±3\pm\sqrt3±3​ 处有跳跃。由Theorem 5.3定理 5.3，这样的源不会产生 ∣kurt⁡∣|\kurt|∣kurt∣ 的局部极大点；有两个这样的源时，Ψ\PsiΨ 对它们所在平面内的任何旋转都无动于衷，因为该平面上的每个投影的峭度都为零。更一般地，只要一个源的峭度与标准误 V/T\sqrt{V/T}V/T​ 相比很小，峭度在实践中就看不见它，无论它在其他方面多么非高斯。

All three weaknesses have the same cause: the function u4u^4u4 grows fast, so the estimate depends on rare large values and needs high moments to be stable. Chapter 6第 6 章 derives contrasts from likelihood and information theory and approximates them with slowly growing functions such as log⁡cosh⁡u\log\cosh ulogcoshu. Their sample averages have small variance under weak moment conditions, a single outlier has bounded or at most linear influence, and they respond to non-Gaussianity that kurtosis misses, including the zero-kurtosis source above (Figure 6.1图 6.1).

这三个弱点出自同一个原因：函数 u4u^4u4 增长太快，估计依赖于少见的大值，需要高阶矩才能稳定。Chapter 6第 6 章从似然与信息论出发构造对比函数，并用 log⁡cosh⁡u\log\cosh ulogcoshu 这类增长缓慢的函数来近似它们。在较弱的矩条件下，这些函数的样本平均方差很小，单个离群值的影响有界或至多是线性的，而且它们能察觉峭度察觉不到的非高斯性，包括上面那个峭度为零的源（Figure 6.1图 6.1）。

5.7 Centering, standardization and implementation checks中心化、标准化与实现检查

Packages often report excess kurtosis m^4,c/m^2,c2−3\hat m_{4,c}/\hat m_{2,c}^2-3m^4,c​/m^2,c2​−3, with sample-centered moments m^r,c=T−1∑t(yt−yˉ)r\hat m_{r,c}=T^{-1}\sum_t(y_t-\bar y)^rm^r,c​=T−1∑t​(yt​−yˉ​)r. This is different from the unnormalized fourth cumulant m^4,c−3m^2,c2\hat m_{4,c}-3\hat m_{2,c}^2m^4,c​−3m^2,c2​ unless the chosen sample variance is exactly one. Record the variance divisor and any finite-sample bias correction; otherwise comparing formulas, software outputs and theoretical kurtoses can mix incompatible conventions.

软件常报告超额峭度 m^4,c/m^2,c2−3\hat m_{4,c}/\hat m_{2,c}^2-3m^4,c​/m^2,c2​−3，其中样本中心矩为 m^r,c=T−1∑t(yt−yˉ)r\hat m_{r,c}=T^{-1}\sum_t(y_t-\bar y)^rm^r,c​=T−1∑t​(yt​−yˉ​)r。除非采用的样本方差恰为一，它不同于未归一化四阶累积量 m^4,c−3m^2,c2\hat m_{4,c}-3\hat m_{2,c}^2m^4,c​−3m^2,c2​。应记录方差分母以及是否使用有限样本偏差修正，否则容易把公式、软件输出和理论峭度的不同约定混在一起。

For a zero-mean, unit-variance source with finite eighth moment, the first-order influence of centering and standardizing is

对零均值、单位方差且八阶矩有限的源，中心化与标准化的一阶影响为

hs(y)=y4−m4−2m4(y2−1)−4m3y,T(κ^s,c−κ)=1T∑t=1Ths(yt)+oP(1).(5.8)h_{\mathrm{s}}(y)=y^4-m_4-2m_4(y^2-1)-4m_3y,\qquad \sqrt T(\hat\kappa_{\mathrm{s},c}-\kappa)=\frac1{\sqrt T}\sum_{t=1}^T h_{\mathrm{s}}(y_t)+o_P(1).\tag{5.8}hs​(y)=y4−m4​−2m4​(y2−1)−4m3​y,T​(κ^s,c​−κ)=T​1​t=1∑T​hs​(yt​)+oP​(1).(5.8)

The term −4m3y-4m_3y−4m3​y comes from estimating the mean; the term −2m4(y2−1)-2m_4(y^2-1)−2m4​(y2−1) comes from estimating the variance. Expanding the variance of this mean-zero polynomial gives Var⁡(hs)=Vs+16m32(1+m4)−8m3m5\Var(h_{\mathrm{s}})=V_{\mathrm{s}}+16m_3^2(1+m_4)-8m_3m_5Var(hs​)=Vs​+16m32​(1+m4​)−8m3​m5​. The correction disappears for symmetric sources, but not in general. These formulas concern a fixed marginal under i.i.d. sampling; maximizing kurtosis over directions and using temporally dependent data introduce additional estimation and dependence issues.

−4m3y-4m_3y−4m3​y 来自均值估计，−2m4(y2−1)-2m_4(y^2-1)−2m4​(y2−1) 来自方差估计。展开这个零均值多项式的方差得到 Var⁡(hs)=Vs+16m32(1+m4)−8m3m5\Var(h_{\mathrm{s}})=V_{\mathrm{s}}+16m_3^2(1+m_4)-8m_3m_5Var(hs​)=Vs​+16m32​(1+m4​)−8m3​m5​。对称源的修正项消失，一般情形则不能省略。这些公式针对独立同分布抽样下的固定边缘分布；在多个方向上搜索最大峭度，或处理有时间依赖的数据，还会带来额外的估计和依赖问题。

A safe fixed-point implementation must stop on a near-zero update before normalization, report an exhausted iteration budget, and compare directions up to sign. Zero-kurtosis sources can cause such a degenerate update even in the population. A sign flip is not a convergence failure; a small change in the contrast alone is not proof that the direction has converged. After convergence, inspect sensitivity to initial values, sample splitting and outliers rather than treating the stopping flag as a separation certificate.

可靠的不动点实现应在归一化之前识别近零更新，达到迭代上限时报告未收敛，并在忽略符号的意义下比较方向。即使在总体中，零峭度源也可能产生这种退化更新。符号翻转不是收敛失败；对比函数变化很小也不等于方向已经收敛。收敛后仍应检查初值、分样本和离群值敏感性，而不能把停止标志当作分离成功的证明。

Key points

本章要点

  • For whitened data a projection is y=q⊤sy = \bq^\top\bsy=q⊤s with ∥q∥=1\|\bq\| = 1∥q∥=1, and kurt⁡(y)=∑iqi4κi\kurt(y) = \sum_i q_i^4\kappa_ikurt(y)=∑i​qi4​κi​. Its absolute value never exceeds max⁡i∣κi∣\max_i|\kappa_i|maxi​∣κi​∣: mixing cannot create kurtosis.
  • The local maxima of ∣kurt⁡(w⊤z)∣|\kurt(\bw^\top\bz)|∣kurt(w⊤z)∣ on the unit sphere are exactly ±\pm± the source directions with nonzero kurtosis (Delfosse & Loubaton, 1995). The other critical points, with qi2∝1/κiq_i^2 \propto 1/\kappa_iqi2​∝1/κi​ on a support of size at least two, are not maxima, so one-unit searches have no spurious solutions.
  • The absolute value matters: when all sources are sub-Gaussian, maximizing kurt⁡\kurtkurt itself finds the most mixed direction. Comon's contrast ∑ikurt⁡(yi)2\sum_i\kurt(y_i)^2∑i​kurt(yi​)2 over rotations is maximized exactly at separating solutions when at most one source has zero kurtosis.
  • The fixed-point iteration w←E[z(w⊤z)3]−3w\bw \leftarrow \E[\bz(\bw^\top\bz)^3] - 3\bww←E[z(w⊤z)3]−3w acts as qi↦κiqi3q_i \mapsto \kappa_i q_i^3qi​↦κi​qi3​ in source coordinates and converges cubically; deflation finds the sources one after another.
  • The sample kurtosis has variance about V/TV/TV/T, where VVV depends on moments up to order eight (24 for the Gaussian, more than 1000 for the Laplace law), unbounded sensitivity to outliers, and no response to non-Gaussian sources with zero kurtosis. These weaknesses motivate the contrasts of Chapter 6第 6 章.
  • 对白化数据，投影为 y=q⊤sy = \bq^\top\bsy=q⊤s，∥q∥=1\|\bq\| = 1∥q∥=1，且 kurt⁡(y)=∑iqi4κi\kurt(y) = \sum_i q_i^4\kappa_ikurt(y)=∑i​qi4​κi​。其绝对值永远不超过 max⁡i∣κi∣\max_i|\kappa_i|maxi​∣κi​∣：混合不会制造峭度。
  • ∣kurt⁡(w⊤z)∣|\kurt(\bw^\top\bz)|∣kurt(w⊤z)∣ 在单位球面上的局部极大点恰好是峭度非零的源方向及其反方向（Delfosse & Loubaton, 1995）。其余临界点在大小至少为二的支撑集上满足 qi2∝1/κiq_i^2 \propto 1/\kappa_iqi2​∝1/κi​，都不是极大点，因此单单元搜索没有伪解。
  • 绝对值不能省：所有源都是亚高斯时，直接最大化 kurt⁡\kurtkurt 会找到混合最充分的方向。若至多一个源的峭度为零，Comon 对比函数 ∑ikurt⁡(yi)2\sum_i\kurt(y_i)^2∑i​kurt(yi​)2 在旋转上的最大值恰好在分离解处取得。
  • 不动点迭代 w←E[z(w⊤z)3]−3w\bw \leftarrow \E[\bz(\bw^\top\bz)^3] - 3\bww←E[z(w⊤z)3]−3w 在源坐标下就是 qi↦κiqi3q_i \mapsto \kappa_i q_i^3qi​↦κi​qi3​，三次收敛；逐个提取依次找出各个源。
  • 样本峭度的方差约为 V/TV/TV/T，其中 VVV 依赖于直到八阶的矩（高斯分布为 24，拉普拉斯分布超过 1000）；它对离群值的敏感性无界，对峭度为零的非高斯源毫无反应。这些弱点促成了Chapter 6第 6 章中的对比函数。

Carry these three ideas forward带走这三点

  • Compare equal-variance directions and use the absolute kurtosis score.
  • The population source-direction theorem has explicit independence and moment assumptions.
  • Outliers, zero kurtosis and sample fluctuations can defeat this contrast.
  • 在方差相同的方向之间比较，使用峭度的绝对值评分。
  • 总体源方向定理有明确的独立性与矩条件。
  • 离群值、零峭度和样本波动都可能使该对比函数失效。

Start with the two-source mixtures, then maximizing without the absolute value. Both can be solved from the combination rule before learning Lagrange multipliers.

先做两源混合题，再做不取绝对值的最大化题。两题都可直接使用组合公式解决，无需先学 Lagrange 乘子。

Three iterations suffice. Squaring gives (1/2)2k(1/2)^{2^k}(1/2)2k, which falls below 10−810^{-8}10−8 only when 2k≥272^k \ge 272k≥27, that is after k=5k = 5k=5 steps. With sample averages the iteration converges to the fixed point of the sample criterion, which differs from the exact source direction by the statistical error discussed in Chapter 10第 10 章.

Exercise 5.6习题 5.6 advanced硬核

Let y=Qs\by = \bQ\bsy=Qs with Q\bQQ orthogonal and independent sources with kurtoses κp\kappa_pκp​. (a) Show that cum⁡(yi,yj,yk,yl)=∑pκpQipQjpQkpQlp\cum(y_i, y_j, y_k, y_l) = \sum_p \kappa_p Q_{ip}Q_{jp}Q_{kp}Q_{lp}cum(yi​,yj​,yk​,yl​)=∑p​κp​Qip​Qjp​Qkp​Qlp​. (b) Show that ∑i,j,k,lcum⁡(yi,yj,yk,yl)2=∑pκp2\sum_{i,j,k,l} \cum(y_i, y_j, y_k, y_l)^2 = \sum_p \kappa_p^2∑i,j,k,l​cum(yi​,yj​,yk​,yl​)2=∑p​κp2​ for every orthogonal Q\bQQ. (c) Conclude that maximizing Ψ\PsiΨ in (5.3) is equivalent to minimizing the sum of the squares of all fourth-order cross-cumulants of y\byy, those whose four indices are not all equal.

设 y=Qs\by = \bQ\bsy=Qs，Q\bQQ 正交，各源独立，峭度为 κp\kappa_pκp​。（a）证明 cum⁡(yi,yj,yk,yl)=∑pκpQipQjpQkpQlp\cum(y_i, y_j, y_k, y_l) = \sum_p \kappa_p Q_{ip}Q_{jp}Q_{kp}Q_{lp}cum(yi​,yj​,yk​,yl​)=∑p​κp​Qip​Qjp​Qkp​Qlp​。（b）证明对任意正交矩阵 Q\bQQ，∑i,j,k,lcum⁡(yi,yj,yk,yl)2=∑pκp2\sum_{i,j,k,l} \cum(y_i, y_j, y_k, y_l)^2 = \sum_p \kappa_p^2∑i,j,k,l​cum(yi​,yj​,yk​,yl​)2=∑p​κp2​。（c）由此说明：最大化 (5.3) 中的 Ψ\PsiΨ，等价于最小化 y\byy 的全部四阶交叉累积量（四个下标不全相等者）的平方和。

(a) By multilinearity, cum⁡(yi,yj,yk,yl)=∑p,q,r,tQipQjqQkrQltcum⁡(sp,sq,sr,st)\cum(y_i, y_j, y_k, y_l) = \sum_{p,q,r,t} Q_{ip}Q_{jq}Q_{kr}Q_{lt}\cum(s_p, s_q, s_r, s_t)cum(yi​,yj​,yk​,yl​)=∑p,q,r,t​Qip​Qjq​Qkr​Qlt​cum(sp​,sq​,sr​,st​), and for independent sources the cumulant vanishes unless p=q=r=tp = q = r = tp=q=r=t, in which case it is κp\kappa_pκp​. (b) Squaring and summing,

（a）由多重线性，cum⁡(yi,yj,yk,yl)=∑p,q,r,tQipQjqQkrQltcum⁡(sp,sq,sr,st)\cum(y_i, y_j, y_k, y_l) = \sum_{p,q,r,t} Q_{ip}Q_{jq}Q_{kr}Q_{lt}\cum(s_p, s_q, s_r, s_t)cum(yi​,yj​,yk​,yl​)=∑p,q,r,t​Qip​Qjq​Qkr​Qlt​cum(sp​,sq​,sr​,st​)；对独立的源，除非 p=q=r=tp = q = r = tp=q=r=t，否则该累积量为零，而 p=q=r=tp = q = r = tp=q=r=t 时它等于 κp\kappa_pκp​。（b）平方后求和，

∑i,j,k,l(∑pκpQipQjpQkpQlp)2=∑p,p′κpκp′(∑iQipQip′)4=∑p,p′κpκp′ δpp′=∑pκp2,\sum_{i,j,k,l}\Bigl(\sum_p \kappa_p Q_{ip}Q_{jp}Q_{kp}Q_{lp}\Bigr)^2 = \sum_{p,p'} \kappa_p\kappa_{p'} \Bigl(\sum_i Q_{ip}Q_{ip'}\Bigr)^4 = \sum_{p,p'} \kappa_p\kappa_{p'}\,\delta_{pp'} = \sum_p \kappa_p^2,i,j,k,l∑​(p∑​κp​Qip​Qjp​Qkp​Qlp​)2=p,p′∑​κp​κp′​(i∑​Qip​Qip′​)4=p,p′∑​κp​κp′​δpp′​=p∑​κp2​,

because the columns of Q\bQQ are orthonormal. (c) The terms with i=j=k=li = j = k = li=j=k=l add up to ∑ikurt⁡(yi)2=Ψ\sum_i \kurt(y_i)^2 = \Psi∑i​kurt(yi​)2=Ψ, so Ψ\PsiΨ plus the sum of the squared cross-cumulants equals the constant ∑pκp2\sum_p \kappa_p^2∑p​κp2​. Maximizing one is minimizing the other; at a separating solution all cross-cumulants vanish.

这里用到 Q\bQQ 的各列标准正交。（c）i=j=k=li = j = k = li=j=k=l 的那些项之和为 ∑ikurt⁡(yi)2=Ψ\sum_i \kurt(y_i)^2 = \Psi∑i​kurt(yi​)2=Ψ，所以 Ψ\PsiΨ 与交叉累积量平方和之和等于常数 ∑pκp2\sum_p \kappa_p^2∑p​κp2​。最大化前者就是最小化后者；在分离解处，所有交叉累积量都为零。
